name: TALIWRK
recent: Taliworks 宣布 2026 财年第二次中期单层股息每股 0.25 仙，除息日为 2026 年 9 月 8 日，派发日为 2026 年 9 月 30 日。公司截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收环比增长 9.0%、同比增长 16.0%，净利环比增长 27.7% 但同比减少 14.5%。新闻提到公司关注 Sungai Rasau 项目以提升盈利。

recent_en: Taliworks declared a second interim single-tier dividend of 0.25 sen per share for FY2026, with ex-date on 8 Sep 2026 and payment on 30 Sep 2026. For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 9.0% QoQ and 16.0% YoY, while net income grew 27.7% QoQ but fell 14.5% YoY. News reported the company is eyeing the Sungai Rasau project to lift earnings.
notable_en: Declared a second interim single-tier dividend of 0.25 sen per share for FY2026.
News reported the company is eyeing the Sungai Rasau project to lift earnings.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 129,945,000, up 9.0% QoQ and 16.0% YoY; net income was MYR 11,493,000, up 27.7% QoQ but down 14.5% YoY; net margin was 8.8% versus 7.6% in the prior quarter.
